transfer.title: Backup Activity
transfer.description: Selected Files and Photos go directly to your paired PC over native encrypted LAN. The PC must separately approve your backup folder.
transfer.more: Showing up to 100 jobs; {{count}} remain in the durable journal.

backups.title: Your completed PC backups
backups.description: Only this phone's completed backups on the currently paired PC are listed. Restore creates a new file at a location you choose in Android; existing files and Photos originals are never replaced or deleted.
backups.photosOpen: Verified Photos manifests can restore media into Android Photos. File backups still save to a new document. Existing media is not overwritten; ambiguous imports wait for review.
backups.empty: No completed backups were returned by this PC.
backups.completed: PC backup completed · Local encrypted LAN
backups.restoring: Restore is running in the foreground. Bytes and SHA-256 are verified; Photos import receipts survive interruption. File downloads may leave an incomplete new document after restart.
backups.restored: {{name}} saved to a new file — destination bytes and SHA-256 verified.

photos.pending: {{completed}} / {{total}} Photos assets verified; remaining jobs wait for a user-triggered retry.
photos.completed: {{completed}} / {{total}} Photos assets and supported album metadata verified.
photos.review_required: {{review}} Photos jobs need review. A previous import may already exist or access is uncertain; no second copy is created automatically.
photos.organization_review: {{review}} Photos jobs need album/resource review. Android folders cannot represent every Photos relationship; complete restoration is not assumed.

errors.pairing_required: Pair with a PC before sending files.
errors.cancelled: Restore cancelled. No restore success is assumed.
errors.manifest_invalid: The Photos manifest is incomplete, unsupported or inconsistent. Nothing is imported from it.
errors.photo_permission_lost: Full Photos access is required to verify existing assets safely. Grant access and retry; no duplicate is created.
errors.photo_review_required: Photos import needs review. A previous copy may already exist; no automatic second import is attempted.
errors.destination_unavailable: The restore destination could not be written and read back. Choose another location; no restore success is assumed.
errors.destination_permission_lost: Restore destination access was lost. Choose a new file and retry.
errors.destination_not_empty: The destination is not empty. It was not overwritten or deleted; choose a new file.
errors.restore_cleanup_failed: Restore did not complete and the newly created destination could not be removed. An incomplete file may remain; remove it yourself before retrying to a new file.
errors.native_unsupported: Native LAN transfer is not available on this platform.
errors.source_permission_lost: Source access was lost. Select the original folder again; pending work is retained.
errors.source_changed: The source changed. The previous version will not resume with an old hash.
errors.snapshot_unavailable: The verified local snapshot is unavailable. Pending work is retained.
errors.local_storage_full: Phone storage is full. Free space and retry; pending work is retained.
errors.queue_unavailable: The local queue cannot be read or updated. No progress is assumed.
errors.paused: Sync is paused. Pending work is retained.
errors.denied: The PC denied access. Check pairing and the separate PC backup-folder approval.
errors.invalid_request: The PC rejected this request. Pending work is retained.
errors.not_found: The PC operation was not found. It will not be silently replaced.
errors.conflict: The PC operation does not match this source or offset. Automatic resume is blocked.
errors.hash_mismatch: The verified bytes did not match. Completion was not accepted.
errors.acl_busy: The PC authorization journal is busy. Retry later.
errors.acl_unavailable: PC authorization cannot be verified. File access stays closed.
errors.backup_unavailable: The PC backup folder is unavailable. Reconnect it and retry.
errors.backup_full: PC backup storage is full. Free space on the PC and retry.
errors.backup_busy: The PC backup file is locked. Close the locking application and retry.
errors.backup_permission_denied: The PC cannot access the approved backup folder. Check its permissions.
errors.backup_path_rejected: The PC rejected an unsafe backup path.
errors.backup_scope_changed: The PC backup folder changed. Reselect and explicitly approve it on the PC.
errors.connection_closed: LAN connection interrupted. The job remains queued for verified resume.
errors.lan_unavailable: The paired PC is not reachable over the approved LAN route.
errors.identity_unavailable: Native device identity is unavailable. File access stays closed.
errors.revoked: Pairing was revoked. Files will not be sent under the old pairing.
errors.outcome_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Pending work is retained; no success is assumed.

onboarding.title: Select folders to back up
onboarding.description: Choose your sources, then set a local automatic sync time.
onboarding.sourceRequired: Select at least one source before continuing.
onboarding.sourceUnavailable: This source is inaccessible. Check permissions and select it again.
onboarding.storageDescription: Enter your storage address and credentials to verify the connection.
onboarding.storageTested: Storage access and write capability verified.
onboarding.testError: WebDAV connection could not be verified.
onboarding.invalidTime: Use HH:mm for the local start time.
onboarding.runtimeUnavailable: Kloda native runtime is unavailable. Rebuild the development app.

pairing.title: Pair your phone
pairing.description: Scan the Kloda invitation on your computer. Both devices must be on the same local network.
pairing.scanDescription: Point the rear camera at the computer's Kloda QR code. No manual secret entry is available.
pairing.cameraPermission: Camera access is used only to scan this pairing invitation.
pairing.cameraDenied: Camera permission is denied. Allow access to scan; pairing cannot proceed without a QR scan.
pairing.cameraError: Camera permission could not be checked or requested.
pairing.cameraUnavailable: The rear camera could not be opened. It may be unavailable or in use by another app.
pairing.cameraPaused: The camera is paused while Kloda is in the background.
pairing.noFileGrant: Pairing establishes device trust only. It does not grant access to files, folders or photos.
pairing.cancelConsequences: Cancellation affects this phone's attempt or local binding only. The computer may retain a committed record; this is not distributed rollback.
pairing.unknownDescription: An interrupted operation is not proof of success or rollback. Read native status, or explicitly resume or cancel a saved attempt.
pairing.leaveConsequences: Leaving closes this view and its connection. It does not complete pairing or delete saved pending or pinned records.
pairing.repairDescription: This computer's previous local trust was revoked. Check the authenticated computer fingerprint before explicitly pairing again.
pairing.repairConsequences: The old revoked record and all file-access denies remain unchanged. A new attempt still requires approval on the computer.
pairing.helpComputer: Open the phone-pairing invitation in Kloda on your computer. After scanning, approve the exact phone candidate there.
pairing.helpLan: Keep both devices on the same local network. Pairing does not use a remote relay or accept a manually entered secret.
pairing.helpRecovery: A saved pending record is not a completed pairing. Resume retries the same native-owned identity binding; cancellation does not delete the computer's record.

unpair.title: Remove pairing with this computer?
unpair.description: When reachable, the PC must confirm durable revocation first. Phone-only removal does not revoke the PC’s permissions. Backed-up photos are not deleted.
unpair.pc_confirmed: The PC durably revoked device trust and file permissions. Pairing was removed on this phone; backed-up photos were preserved.
unpair.local_only: Pairing was removed only on this phone. PC revocation was not confirmed; its old permissions may remain. A new QR pairing is required to reconnect.
unpair.pc_unconfirmed: The PC did not confirm durable revocation. Pairing has not been removed on this phone. Retry, or explicitly remove only on this phone.

idle.title: Ready to scan
idle.description: Create a fresh invitation on the computer, then scan its QR code.

open.title: Invitation open
open.description: The invitation is active, but no device trust has been established.

connecting.title: Connecting securely
connecting.description: Native Kloda is checking the computer and local connection. No durable pending record or trust pin is confirmed yet.

reserved.title: Waiting for computer approval
reserved.description: The computer has reserved a candidate. Only an explicit decision on the computer can approve normal pairing.

pending.title: Pairing pending
pending.description: This phone saved a pending binding. The computer's commitment has not yet been confirmed. Check the candidate on your computer.

consumed_pending_ack.title: Pinned; completion pending
consumed_pending_ack.description: The computer's identity is durably pinned on this phone. The completion exchange is not confirmed; resume can recover the same pair.

complete.title: Pairing complete
complete.description: This phone saved the computer's trust pin and received the completion exchange. File access still requires separate authorization.

invalid.title: Attempt ended
invalid.description: This invitation is no longer active. A computer-side record may remain; do not assume rollback.

revoked.title: Disabled on this phone
revoked.description: The local attempt or binding is disabled. Any computer-side trust and file-access denies remain separate.

errors.invalid_qr: This is not a valid Kloda pairing QR.
errors.unsupported_version: This QR uses an unsupported pairing version.
errors.lan_unavailable: A permitted local-network route is unavailable.
errors.native_unsupported: Secure native pairing is unavailable in this app build. Use a supported Kloda native build; no pairing has been simulated.
errors.identity_unavailable: Kloda's hardware-protected device identity is unavailable.
errors.continuity_lost: The saved local identity or installation continuity cannot be verified. Automatic trust recovery is blocked.
errors.tls_rejected: The computer's authenticated TLS identity was rejected.
errors.proof_rejected: The pairing proof was rejected by native Kloda.
errors.invitation_expired: The invitation expired. Create a fresh QR on the computer.
errors.candidate_stale: This exact candidate is no longer current. Read native status before making another decision.
errors.already_paired: This computer already has an active local pairing.
errors.storage_failure: The required durable pairing record could not be written or read. Completion is not confirmed.
errors.connection_closed: The connection closed. Any saved pending or pinned record remains subject to native status and explicit recovery.
errors.outcome_unknown: The pairing outcome cannot be determined. Do not assume completion or rollback.
errors.cancelled: The local operation was cancelled. This does not promise deletion of the computer's record.
errors.revoked: The local pairing is revoked and cannot be resumed.
